about_the_game:
In this demo, you can experience the heart of Atura through three handcrafted levels that showcase the core game mechanics. A relaxing yet challenging strategy and puzzle game where you take on the role of a skilled herding dog in a peaceful, nature-inspired world. With its charming low-poly, paper-craft art style, Atura invites you to navigate intricate courses, adapt to the unpredictable behavior of sheep, and master the art of shepherding through thoughtful movement and strategic positioning.

Whether you're seeking a calm, immersive experience or a test of precision and planning, Atura offers a unique take on herding—rewarding players who can guide their flock efficiently and with care.

Take control of your herding dog from a third-person perspective with simple, intuitive controls. There’s no steep learning curve—just move, position yourself, and gently guide your flock.

short_description: Guide a herd of sheep as a herding dog. Use timing and precision to navigate obstacles and complete each trial. Master the art of sheep herding and adapt to unpredictable animal behavior. Relaxing yet engaging, this game will test your skills and quick thinking in a unique and natural setting.
